---
title: "Information Denial"
description: "Deliberate suppression or blocking of factual information to remove access entirely."
categories: ["Command and Control"]
---

::: {.function-badge}
[Command and Control](../function/command-and-control.qmd)
:::

Covers deliberate suppression or blocking of factual reporting (banning foreign correspondents, jamming satellite signals). Distinct from Obfuscation because it removes access entirely rather than disguising the origin.
